characters.name: The Newman Family
characters.description: One of the core families (arguably the main one) on The Young and The Restless when the show retooled from a half-hour soap to an one-hour program. The family is well known for it's longstanding feud with the Abbott family, and their family company - the multinational conglomerate Newman Enterprises. Actor Allusion/The Cast Showoff: Victor is a boxing enthusiast, and a very good amateur boxer, as is Eric Braeden Affably Evil: Both Affable and Evil is pushing it, but while he isn't entirely a good person, he can be very friendly, and sometimes outright kind, to the people he cares about. Big Bad/Big Good: Amazingly depending on the storyline Victor can be either one of these, or in some strange cases both at the same time. Corrupt Corporate Executive: Many times over the years. He has most recently been accused of allowing a subsidiary to sell illegal "energy pills" online...which may or may not be his fault.
